categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, production, and sales of polyether ether ketone (PEEK) high-performance engineering plastics. Its product portfolio includes pure resin and composite reinforced resins with various grades and forms such as powders and pellets, serving industries like automotive, electronics, medical, aerospace, and energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary technologies for PEEK synthesis, purification, and composite reinforcement, including innovative polymerization methods using sodium salts, two-step synthesis, large-scale reactor design, end-capping techniques, and advanced purification processes. It also employs automated DCS control systems for precise production management and has established comprehensive quality evaluation systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include downstream processors in automotive, electronics, semiconductor, medical implant, aerospace, and energy sectors. The company targets high-end applications requiring materials with excellent mechanical, thermal, and chemical resistance properties, focusing on markets demanding lightweight, durable, and high-performance polymer materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Changchun, Jilin Province. It has expanded its market reach domestically and initiated overseas warehouse construction to better serve European customers, though export sales remain a smaller portion of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the supply chain, focusing on the industrial-scale synthesis and production of PEEK resin and composite materials. It supplies raw and semi-processed polymer materials to downstream processors and manufacturers who produce finished components and products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing production automation, expanding R&D capabilities with increased investment and talent acquisition, developing new PEEK grades and composite materials for emerging applications such as medical implants and aerospace CF/PEEK composites, and pursuing international market expansion. The company emphasizes innovation to maintain technological leadership and broaden application fields.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of PEEK resin products and composite materials to industrial customers. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, with income derived from product sales rather than licensing or subscription.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the largest PEEK producer in China and ranks as the fourth largest globally by production capacity, following industry leaders like Victrex (UK), Solvay (Belgium), and Evonik (Germany). It has surpassed some international competitors in the domestic market and holds a leading position in large-scale industrial PEEK production.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 277 million, a slight decline from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 39 million. Despite revenue pressure from price adjustments, the company has shown growth in production volume and total assets, with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D driving future growth potential.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers domestically produced PEEK materials with performance metrics meeting or exceeding international standards, breaking foreign monopolies. Its products feature high purity, batch stability, and tailored composite formulations, enabling applications in demanding environments. The company’s integrated technology, quality control, and certification portfolio provide customers with reliable, high-performance alternatives to imported materials.
